headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.7% - Largest Increase Among G20
key_headlines.summary: International organizations including OECD and ADB have significantly raised South Korea's economic growth projections, citing strong semiconductor exports and expected consumer recovery. However, high oil prices pose inflation risks with estimates reaching 3% levels.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Falls to 1,350 Won as Oil Prices Decline
key_headlines.summary: The won strengthened as oil prices fell due to easing US-Iran tensions and Saudi Arabia's expected crude export expansion. Oil price movements have become the key variable determining exchange rate direction amid strong semiconductor export performance.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Nuclear Reactor Project Advances in US Market with 8-Unit Proposal
key_headlines.summary: South Korea and the US are reviewing construction of 6 Westinghouse AP1000 reactors and 2 Korean APR1400 units, marking a significant opportunity for Korean nuclear technology to enter the US market. Additional costs and workforce challenges remain as major obstacles.

key_headlines.title: Over 22% of Seoul Apartment Transactions Below 600 Million Won Due to Policy Loan Cutoff
key_headlines.summary: One in five apartments traded in Seoul this year were priced at 600 million won or below as buyers concentrated on properties eligible for policy loans. This clustering effect has driven up prices in the sub-600 million won segment amid concerns about low-price apartment disappearance.

key_headlines.title: US AI Infrastructure Investment to Reach 1.4 Quadrillion Won Over 8 Years
key_headlines.summary: The US plans to invest an average of 3.63% of GDP annually in AI infrastructure through 2032, creating 750,000 new jobs. This unprecedented investment scale surpasses the 19th-century railroad boom and reflects AI's critical role in future economic growth.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic outlook has improved dramatically with OECD raising the 2026 growth forecast from 2.6% to 3.7%, the largest increase among G20 nations, driven by strong semiconductor exports and anticipated consumer recovery. The won-dollar exchange rate strengthened to 1,350 won as oil prices declined due to easing geopolitical tensions, though high oil prices continue to pose inflation risks at 3% levels. Korea's nuclear technology is gaining traction in the US market with joint plans to construct 8 reactors. Real estate markets show significant structural shifts with over 22% of Seoul apartment transactions clustering below 600 million won due to policy loan thresholds. The US government is committing an unprecedented 1.4 quadrillion won to AI infrastructure over 8 years, signaling a major global economic reorientation toward artificial intelligence.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 3.75-4.00%, with Fed officials signaling potential for further rate increases to combat persistent inflation. South Korea's business sentiment index reached its highest level in nearly 4 years at 99.6 in August, indicating improving corporate confidence despite global economic headwinds. US consumer inflation expectations surged to 4.6% in September from 4.0% in August, reaching the highest level since June and significantly above February's 3.4% pre-Iran conflict levels. Bank mortgage rates in Korea have risen sharply with even well-qualified borrowers facing minimum fixed-rate mortgages of 5% annually. The high interest rate environment is constraining both consumer spending and investment activity across both Korean and US economies.
sections.Financial Markets: US Treasury yields remain elevated with 10-year rates repeatedly breaking through the 5% psychological resistance level, signaling entry into a new era of high inflation and high interest rates. AI stocks provided support to markets while bond markets experienced some relief as oil prices fell, with 10-year yields retreating from intraday highs. The sharp rise in long-term US interest rates is driving capital outflows from domestic Korean markets and strengthening the dollar relative to the won. Bond market participants are treating current high yields as part of a normalization process, though there remain concerns about AI bond concentration risks. The combination of high government debt levels, fiscal deficits near 5.5% of GDP, and robust AI investment demand continues to put upward pressure on interest rates globally.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's traditional manufacturing regions including Jeollanam-do and Gwangju are undergoing industrial transformation focused on semiconductors and artificial intelligence replacing automotive, petrochemical, and shipbuilding sectors. US semiconductor inspection equipment manufacturers have seen valuations surge dramatically with one company increasing 3.4 times in value over a year to reach 13.8 trillion won market capitalization. A case of semiconductor technology theft resulted in actual sentences for both the employee who leaked trade secrets and the receiving company's executive, highlighting security risks in the industry. Vocational high schools in Jeollanam-do and Gwangju are being positioned as semiconductor talent centers with job placement programs extending from education to employment. The semiconductor sector continues to drive Korea's export performance and corporate sentiment improvements.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's rental market shows accelerating jeonse-to-wolse conversion with monthly rentals exceeding jeonse transactions for seven consecutive months as deposit-based leasing becomes increasingly scarce. Apartment-hotels (apart-tels) are emerging as attractive alternatives as housing prices surge, with 5,600 units entering presale after Chuseok. Over 50,000 apartment subscription winners in the past six years have been disqualified due to errors in non-home-owner period calculations and other eligibility issues, with the highest disqualification rate occurring in 2021 during market overheating. Next week is expected to see 3,641 new housing units entering the presale market nationally. Rising housing prices and stricter lending standards have created a bifurcated market where buyers concentrate on properties just below policy loan thresholds.
sections.International Economy: The US and China agreed to shift AI terminology to SI and extend trade war ceasefire until January 10, 2027, with discussions on 30 billion dollars in tariff reductions and China committing to purchase minimum 10 million tons of US coal annually in 2027-2028. Critical issues including rare earth minerals, semiconductor equipment export controls, and supply chain vulnerabilities remain unresolved despite reduced tensions. Trump's expansionary fiscal policies are creating headwinds for AI infrastructure investments through rising interest rates, threatening the momentum of technology-driven economic growth. Federal Reserve futures markets reflect approximately 70% probability of additional rate increases at the October FOMC meeting as inflation concerns persist. US media assessments of the Trump-Xi meeting suggest limited breakthrough solutions despite official claims of productivity.
sections.AI & Economy: Hyundai Motor Group's 8.9 trillion won Saemangeum investment is catalyzing Jeollabuk-do's industrial transformation with three pillars of physical AI-robotics, clean hydrogen, and AI data centers expected to generate 16 trillion won in production-induced effects and 71,000 jobs. The US is undertaking AI infrastructure investment averaging 3.63% of GDP annually through 2032, creating 750,000 new jobs and exceeding historical infrastructure projects like the 19th-century railroad boom at 2.24% of GDP. Anthropic has postponed its IPO to November due to rising interest rates and growing doubts about AI investment sustainability, with companies now needing to demonstrate revenue structures capable of sustaining massive computing costs. Jeollabuk-do is establishing a comprehensive industrial ecosystem linking 14 cities and counties around Hyundai's investment in robotics, hydrogen, and AI data centers. Global AI leaders including Anthropic, OpenAI, and DeepMind are advocating for AI speed controls for human safety, though this narrative is losing momentum.
sections.Others: August 2026 was recorded as the hottest month in human history at 16.96 degrees Celsius, marginally exceeding July 2023's previous record, with unusually high temperatures extending into September. Extreme heat waves have negatively impacted aircraft performance efficiency, adding operational challenges to the aviation industry amid ongoing climate change impacts. Financial investment firms are recommending US index funds, AI semiconductor ETFs, and monthly dividend-paying funds to holiday bonus recipients seeking stable long-term returns and reduced market volatility. The Customs Service has eliminated caps on whistleblower reward amounts and introduced progressive payment systems with up to three-fold bonuses for insider reports to combat increasingly sophisticated smuggling and tariff evasion. Global climate data platforms are making comprehensive climate monitoring information freely available to support research and policy decisions related to temperature trends and environmental changes.
